bugs.title: Page number past the last page shows an empty list while the pager highlights the last page (releases list has no message at all)
bugs.reason: With ?page=99 the releases list is blank with no wording under a '15 Releases' header and the pager marks page 2 as current; the tags list does the same with 'No results found.' under '16 Tags'. The handlers query with the raw page number while the paginator clamps the current page to the last one, so the page contradicts itself; nothing in the source shows this is intended.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/routers/web/repo/release.go (Releases, TagsList: raw ctx.FormInt("page") goes to the query)

bugs.title: 'Create Tag Only' button does not follow the tag name in the field: gone after a duplicate-release error, offered for an existing tag typed by hand
bugs.reason: The button is decided once by the server at render time: after 'A release with this tag name already exists.' it is removed and only a reload (losing the typed values) brings it back, and after typing v1.0.0 ('Existing tag.') it is still offered and only yields the same error. The handler's own comment calls this 'still not completely right ... the "tag only" button is gone' and says frontend code is needed to toggle it when the input changes.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/routers/web/repo/release.go (NewReleasePost: comment above ctx.Data["ShowCreateTagOnlyButton"] = form.TagOnly || rel == nil)

bugs.title: Tag page of v1.0.0 has no edit pencil
bugs.reason: v1.0.0 is a plain git tag, not a release: its page highlights the 'Tags' tab, which the template only does for IsTag entries. The template deliberately hides the pencil on a single tag page and offers 'New Release' (prefilled with the tag) instead; the drafts that show the pencil are real release records.

bugs.title: Archive download link of a missing tag answers a plain-text 404 line instead of the styled 404 page
bugs.reason: The download handler explicitly answers a plain-text 404 carrying the error text for an unknown ref (ctx.HTTPError), i.e. a deliberate choice for a file-download endpoint also used by non-browser clients. The status is a correct 404 and the line names the missing reference; it is not a crash or stack trace.

bugs.title: New Release helper says 'New tag. This tag will be created from the target.' for the tag name of an existing draft release
bugs.reason: The helper is computed from the repository's real git tags only (releases with a commit id); a draft release has no git tag until it is published, so 'New tag' is accurate and the banner correctly reports the release-name clash. The claim that agent15-tag-alex was a real tag is not shown: the page re-rendered by the server after the POST still classifies it as new.

bugs.title: Repository activity RSS feed: item titles carry HTML anchor markup (and HTML-escaped names) instead of plain text
bugs.reason: Every in /eval/harbor-handbook.rss is 'eval pushed tag <a href=...>name</a> to <a href=...>repo</a>' (XML-escaped), so feed readers show literal markup and a tag named <x> appears as <x>. The code concatenates an HTML translation string into the title and carries a TODO saying the text/HTML mix is 'quite strange (maybe not right)', so it is not a design choice.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/routers/web/feed/convert.go (feedActionsToFeedItems: Title: template.HTMLEscapeString(title) + string(titleExtra); TODO comment at the top of the loop)

bugs.title: Saving a draft release moves its date to the save time and puts it first in the list
bugs.reason: Deliberate for drafts: the release service sets CreatedUnix to now on every save while the release is still a draft (explicit else-branch), because a draft has no release date yet; the list is ordered by that field. Both findings were made on draft releases only.

bugs.title: Draft release is labelled '<user> released this now' although it was never published
bugs.reason: Cards carrying the 'Draft' badge read 'eval released this now', which is factually wrong for something not released. The template prints the same repo.released_this string for every entry with no draft case; nothing in the source marks this wording as intended for drafts.

bugs.title: Releases RSS feed has no items
bugs.reason: The only non-draft entry the finding relies on, v1.0.0, is a plain git tag (its page highlights the 'Tags' tab), and the releases feed deliberately leaves out plain tags and drafts; the same tag does appear in tags.rss. The evidence shows no published release that is missing from the feed.

bugs.title: Edit form opens for a tag that has no release, and submitting it ends on a 404 page with the typed text lost
bugs.reason: /releases/edit/<tag-only> renders a full 'Update Release' form, but the POST handler answers 404 for tag-only entries, so the typed title/notes are thrown away. The GET handler lacks the IsTag check the POST handler has, an inconsistency rather than a decision. Note: the address is reached by typing it (the UI shows no pencil for plain tags), which is why this is rated 3 and not 5.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/routers/web/repo/release.go (EditRelease has no rel.IsTag check; EditReleasePost: if rel.IsTag { ctx.NotFound(err) })

bugs.title: Tag name on a draft release card is a link with href="#"
bugs.reason: The template deliberately emits '#' when the release has no commit id: a draft created with a new tag name has no git tag until it is published, so there is no tag page to open (drafts on an existing tag, and v1.0.0, do link to /src/tag/...). For the same reason those names are absent from the Tags page. A non-link label would be tidier, but that is a styling preference.

bugs.title: Release notes table with a 155-character unbroken cell is clipped at 390 px
bugs.reason: Rendered tables are deliberately their own horizontal scroll area (display:block; overflow:auto; max-width:100%), so the rest of the table is reached by swiping the table itself; the finding only tried scrolling the page. The evidence does not show the table refusing to scroll.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/web_src/css/markup/content.css (.markup table { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 100%; overflow: auto; })

bugs.title: Pressing Enter in the Release title field runs 'Create Tag Only': a tag is created and the typed title/notes are discarded
bugs.reason: 'Create Tag Only' is the first submit button of the form, so the browser uses it for Enter: the form is posted with tag_only=1, a tag is created, the page jumps to the tag view and no release is saved (the release title is lost). Nothing in the source marks tag-only as the intended default action; 'Publish Release' is the styled primary button.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/templates/repo/release/new.tmpl (button name="tag_only" is first in the button row)

bugs.title: Tags RSS feed leaves out a real tag (v1.0.0) once a draft release is saved on it, while the Tags page still lists it
bugs.reason: tags.rss lists agent15-tag-alpha/-docs but not v1.0.0, which the Tags page shows as an existing tag (row 'Release details', i.e. a draft release now sits on it). The feed query drops every draft row, whereas the Tags page handler states that drafts on a real tag must still be listed as tags; the feed misses that case, so a public tag vanishes from the feed.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/routers/web/repo/release.go (TagsList comment: 'the drafts should also be included because a real tag might be used as a draft')

bugs.title: Tags/releases RSS feed: <guid> is '<id>: <url>' but is not marked isPermaLink="false"
bugs.reason: Items read <guid>22: https://.../releases/tag/agent15-tag-msg</guid> with no isPermaLink attribute, so by the RSS 2.0 rule the guid is declared a permalink yet is not a URL. The id prefix itself is deliberate, but the activity feed in the same file sets IsPermaLink "false" for the same format and the release feed omits it, an oversight. Correction to the finding: the value is '22: https://...', not 'guid22: ...'; no visible effect in common readers.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/routers/web/feed/convert.go (releasesToFeedItems: Id: fmt.Sprintf("%v: %v", rel.ID, link.Href) without IsPermaLink; feedActionsToFeedItems sets IsPermaLink: "false")

bugs.title: /releases/new?tag=<name> opens pre-filled with the existing release's title and notes
bugs.reason: Deliberate: the handler says it pre-fills the form 'with the tag name, target branch and the existing release (if exists)' (the path used to turn a tag into a release). For a tag that already has a real or draft release the address is only reached by typing it (the UI offers that link for plain tags only) and saving is refused with a clear message; the 'New tag' helper is accurate for a draft whose git tag does not exist yet.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/routers/web/repo/release.go (NewRelease: '// pre-fill the form with the tag name, target branch and the existing release (if exists)')

bugs.title: Escape in the target-branch dropdown keeps the option reached with the arrow keys
bugs.reason: The value changes on ArrowDown, before Escape is pressed: the dropdown library's documented default selectOnKeydown=true selects while arrowing (like a closed native select) and Escape only closes the menu. It is the library's designed behaviour for every single-select dropdown in the app, and the new value is visible in the field.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/web_src/fomantic/build/components/dropdown.js (selectOnKeydown: true, '// Whether selection should occur automatically when keyboard shortcuts used'; escape handler only calls module.hide())

bugs.title: 64-character tag name is cut off in the tags list at 390 px
bugs.reason: The tags table is deliberately a fixed, single-line table, so each row stays on one line and overlong content is truncated; the full name is shown on the tag's own page one tap away. Wrapping instead of truncating is a layout preference for an extreme input.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/templates/repo/tag/list.tmpl (<table class="ui very basic striped fixed table single line" id="tags-table">)

bugs.title: Deleting an already-deleted tag from a stale Tags page fails silently: no message and the tag stays listed
bugs.reason: The confirm dialog closes and nothing else happens; the page keeps listing the tag. The server answers 404 for the unknown id and the delete-button script only handles response.ok, so a failed delete gives no feedback at all; the script is marked FIXME/legacy in the source, not a chosen behaviour.

bugs.title: Draft release saved with a new tag name does not create the tag
bugs.reason: Deliberate: the git tag is created only when the release is published ('Only actual create when publish'), so a draft's tag is not in /tags and /src/tag/<name> does not exist yet. The release card shows the tag label without a commit, and the template gives it href '#', not the /src/tag link the finding describes; the 404 comes from opening that address directly.
source: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/v1.24.7/services/release/release.go (createTag: '// Only actual create when publish.' if !rel.IsDraft {...})
